title: Normalized QuickGO Concordance Transition Matrix
description: Validation contract for comparative transition analytics between baseline Stage P3 concordance and PIL-04.1B ontology-enriched recomparison concordance under scheme MFPB_QUICKGO_CONCORDANCE_TRANSITION_V1. Enforces row-level constraints on categorical transitions, null-safe four-decimal Jaccard ranges, integer count types, and foreign key patterns. Relational accounting and delta arithmetic are enforced programmatically by Python validators.

protein_id.description: Resolved catalog entity identifier from candidate v0.3.0 mfp_proteins.csv.

source_id.description: Canonical source catalog identifier (e.g. SRC_MOONPROT, SRC_MULTITASKPROTDB_II, SRC_PLANTMP).

policy_id.description: Concordance policy identifier (Policy B unfiltered inventory or Policy C filtered descriptive overlap).

baseline_concordance_status.description: Binary evaluability flag in the frozen Stage P3 baseline.

recomparison_concordance_status.description: Binary evaluability flag in the PIL-04.1B ontology-enriched recomparison.

evaluability_transition.description: Categorical transition state between baseline and recomparison evaluability.

baseline_primary_reason.description: Governing non-evaluable reason in baseline concordance matrix, or null if evaluable.

recomparison_primary_reason.description: Governing non-evaluable reason in recomparison concordance matrix, or null if evaluable.

primary_reason_transition.description: Categorical transition state between baseline and recomparison governing reasons.

baseline_source_terms_count.description: Baseline count of distinct source GO terms for this aspect, or null if indeterminate/unavailable.

recomparison_source_terms_count.description: Recomparison count of distinct source GO terms for this aspect, or null if indeterminate/unavailable.

delta_source_terms_count.description: Net change in distinct source terms (recomparison - baseline), or null if either side is null.

baseline_quickgo_terms_count.description: Baseline count of distinct QuickGO terms for this aspect, or null if unlinked/absent/unavailable.

recomparison_quickgo_terms_count.description: Recomparison count of distinct QuickGO terms for this aspect, or null if unlinked/absent/unavailable.

delta_quickgo_terms_count.description: Net change in distinct QuickGO terms (recomparison - baseline), or null if either side is null.

baseline_exact_overlap_count.description: Baseline exact set intersection count |S ∩ Q|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

recomparison_exact_overlap_count.description: Recomparison exact set intersection count |S ∩ Q|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

delta_exact_overlap_count.description: Net change in exact set intersection count (recomparison - baseline), or null if either side is null.

baseline_union_terms_count.description: Baseline exact set union count |S ∪ Q|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

recomparison_union_terms_count.description: Recomparison exact set union count |S ∪ Q|, or null if either side is indeterminate/unavailable.

delta_union_terms_count.description: Net change in exact set union count (recomparison - baseline), or null if either side is null.

source_set_content_changed.description: True if the set of source GO IDs differs between baseline and recomparison, even if counts match.

baseline_jaccard_similarity.description: Baseline Jaccard similarity coefficient (rounded to 4 decimal places), or null if not evaluable.

recomparison_jaccard_similarity.description: Recomparison Jaccard similarity coefficient (rounded to 4 decimal places), or null if not evaluable.

delta_jaccard_similarity.description: Null-safe score difference rounded to 4 decimals (recomparison - baseline), or null if either is null.

metric_transition.description: Score-specific transition category reflecting Jaccard coefficient shifts.

overall_transition_classification.description: Comprehensive summary transition state evaluated by strict deterministic precedence.

notes.description: Curatorial or diagnostic transition notes, or null.
